title: Our development goals must move alongside sustainable future: Yadav
description:
India believes that environmental protection and development must advance together, with climate resilience centred on people, livelihoods and ecosystems, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav said on Tuesday during an event at COP31 being held in Turkiye's Antalya.
The minister also highlighted India's experience in coastal resilience and cited the Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes (MISHTI), which advances mangrove conservation and restoration while supporting coastal livelihoods.
Yadav made these comments at an event on 'India-SIDS (Small Island Developing States) Partnership for Resilient Coasts and Oceans: Sharing Knowledge, Technology and Solutions'.
During his address, the minister identified four priority areas for enhanced India-SIDS cooperation, the first one being coastal risk assessment, shoreline monitoring and early warning systems.
